caveat: Circular sanity check, not an evaluation. These labels record which synthetic lines were written to look suspicious, taken from the hand checks in level-2-build/README.md. The same hand wrote the lines, the rules and the labels, so precision and recall on them cannot show how the rules behave on real logs.

E1.what: alice: 6 failed SSH logins in 9 minutes

E2.what: bob: 4 failed SSH logins, written as a near miss below the threshold of 5

E4.what: firewall allow and deny lines, read by no rule

E6.what: listening port 8080, outside baseline ports 22 and 9090

E7.what: listening ports 9090 and 22, inside the baseline

E9.what: guest: 2 sudo to root, not an admin user

E10.what: labadmin and laboperator: sudo to root, approved admins
